item.title: Pull Over in Central California for French-ish Fine-ish Dining
item.description: To dine at Bell’s is to fall in love with the Santa Ynez Valley. item.title: The Weekly Fish and Chips Special That Focuses on Sustainability
item.description: Fish and chips is a once-a-week special at the Ojai, California, restaurant Rory’s Place. The nostalgic dish — which the owners, siblings Maeve and Rory McAuliffe, grew up eating during family trips to Cape Cod — is served only on Wednesdays.
